subject: replace-with-your-subject
title: One Attempt Is Not a Verdict (SOFTWARE FIXTURE)
thesis: A limited observation does not alone establish a universal conclusion
limits: Logical illustration only; no measured effects

chapters.title: What follows
chapters.objective: Separate one observation from a universal conclusion
chapters.supported_conclusion: One attempt alone is not a universal proof

chapters.title: A bounded choice
chapters.entering_belief: A new attempt must guarantee success
chapters.supported_conclusion: Choosing another attempt need not promise its result
